issue_request: FHIR-5707 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care issue about ProcedureRequest and Procedure status values. The final resolution added aborted plus in-progress, entered-in-error, and completed to Procedure status, and deferred further ProcedureRequest status discussion.
initial_application: Commit 140947a909f933c7c04cfbfa38eb1ece8be5e0b5 added Procedure.status with in-progress, completed, and entered-in-error. Commit 0136d72a7b0c4246350f85195b5ffcd2cc19e3d3, explicitly for #5707, added aborted to the old Procedure status list. No direct ProcedureRequest status edit was expected because that part was deferred.
additional_context: Procedure and ServiceRequest are active current resources; ProcedureRequest is recorded in source/fhir.ini only as merged into ServiceRequest. Later workflow alignment, terminology, and reconciliation decisions replaced the old local Procedure status terms with Event Status and separated request authorization/intention status from fulfillment status through ServiceRequest/Request guidance. FHIR-6877 is already represented on the combined branch and confirms the same Request/Event split.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source preserves the applied Procedure status through the modern Event Status binding and addresses the deferred ProcedureRequest concern through ServiceRequest/Request workflow guidance, so no source edit is required.
